basic_info.description: Nestled in sought-after Noe Valley, this stunning top-floor duplex captivates with breathtaking southern views, an open modern layout, and soaring ceilings. The living room is bathed in natural light from an overhead skylight, showcasing exquisite features like exposed brick, rich hardwood floors, and a charming fireplace. Designed for seamless flow, the open-concept kitchen connects effortlessly to the living area and offers access to the private deck, where you can take in the sweeping city and hillside vistas. The main level includes two spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a versatile flex room ideal for a home office, study or guest quarters. Additional conveniences include garage parking, a large shared storage room, and access to a communal backyard patio. Just moments from the vibrant 24th Street Corridor, enjoy popular spots like Noe Valley Bakery, Saru Sushi Bar, Novy Greek Restaurant, and La Boulangerie, plus easy access to MUNI and major freeways.
